QuestInfo.name: [Alliance] You Are Not Alone
QuestInfo.0: Go apologize to #p1101000#. After all, you almost took her life.
QuestInfo.1:
#p1101000# wanted to know why you left without letting her say thanks. She also wants to know why you won't join their side, despite having the same enemy.

Hundreds of years ago, there were only five people brave enough to fight the Black Mage. Now, there's a whole world waiting to take him on...

Trust them. Join them. This time, you've got nothing to lose.
